data.standardized_narrative: Insufficient machine-readable detail was available in the provided images to extract a gross prior-year reserve movement figure. The opening gross claims outstanding (prior-year comparative column from the Statement of Financial Position - "Claims outstanding") was located as 313.8 (statement currency). Gross written premium for the year is visible as 271.2 (statement currency). The report contains a gross claims development table (triangle) and other notes, but the gross prior-year movement line in the notes could not be unambiguously read from the images. As a result the prior-year development (gross) is not reported here and further review of the original PDF with higher-resolution/OCR is required to produce an exact gross PYD figure and line-by-line LOB reserve movements.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction uncertainty: the provided images are low-resolution for text extraction. The opening gross claims outstanding (prior-year column) was read from the Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities: Claims outstanding) as 313.8 (USD millions) on page 14. The total gross written premium 271.2 (USD millions) was read from the segmental/geographical premium table (page ~25). A gross prior-year movement (Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding / explicit gross prior year development) could not be unambiguously located/read in gross form. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 29) but the detailed numeric cells were not reliably OCR'd here to compute prior-year development. Where gross movement figures were not available, I have left the prior_year_development fields null rather than substitute a net figure. Recommend supplying the original PDF (higher-resolution) or running OCR to extract the movement-in-prior-years note and the segmental premium table for exact LOB splits.
